shortDescription: Backup and restore BIG-IP Next instance configration through CM

options.name: device_hostname
options.description: The hostname of the BIG-IP Next instance to back up config on. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(device_ip). The parameter is required when C(state) is C(backup) or C(restore).

options.name: device_ip
options.description: The ip address of the BIG-IP Next instance to back up config on. Parameter mutually exclusive with C(device_hostname). The parameter is required when C(state) is C(backup) or C(restore).

options.name: file_password
options.description: The encryption password for the given backup file as defined in C(filename). The parameter is required when C(state) is C(backup) or C(restore).

options.name: filename
options.description: The name of the file to save the BIG-IP Next instance backup. System automatically appends .tar.gz extension to filenames provided without it.

options.name: force
options.description: When C(true), removes the existing backup file and creates new one on the CM. When C(false), no backup is created if a file with given name exists.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(backup), ensures the backup is file is created. When C(restore), ensures the target BIG-IP Next instance is restored from the given backup filename. When C(absent), ensures the backup file is removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The amount of time in seconds to wait for the backup or restore operation to complete. The accepted value range is between C(150) and C(3600) seconds.
